skill.name: Understand Virtual Hub Routing Architecture
skill.description: Reference skill providing foundational knowledge of virtual hub routing concepts, terminology, and architectural relationships. Covers hub route tables, routing intent and policies, connections, association, propagation, labels, and static route configuration. Enables practitioners to design hub routing policies and diagnose routing behavior.
skill.skill_body:
Use this reference to understand virtual hub routing architecture and terminology. Review routing concepts (hub route tables, routing intent, policies, connections, association, propagation, labels) and static route configuration for virtual network connections. Consult when designing routing policies or troubleshooting routing behavior.

## Objective

understand_hub_routing_architecture
## Applicable Signals

- Practitioner needs to understand routing concepts before configuration
- Design phase requires knowledge of hub route tables and policies
- Routing issue diagnosis requires understanding of association and propagation

## Contraindications

- Do not use when executing immediate operational configuration tasks
- Do not use when seeking step-by-step configuration procedures
- Not suitable for real-time troubleshooting without operational context

## Constraints

- Applies to Standard Virtual WAN customers
- Router manages routing between gateways using BGP
- Virtual hub supports up to 50 Gbps aggregate throughput

## Output Contract

- Practitioner gains foundational understanding of routing concepts, terminology, and architectural relationships needed to design hub routing policies and understand routing behavior
